UNREADABLE_AUDIO: We couldn't read the audio in {filename}. The file may be corrupt or contain no audio.
EPISODE_TOO_LONG: This episode is {duration_minutes, number} minutes and the limit is {max_minutes, number}. There are {allowance_hours_today, number} hours of audio left today — splitting it in two would work.
UPLOAD_COST_PREVIEW: This episode will use {share_of_daily, number, percent} of today's allowance, which is {daily_allowance_hours, number} hours.
UPLOAD_INTERRUPTED: The upload was interrupted. Nothing was lost — just try again.
CHUNK_FAILED: Part {chunk_index, number} of {chunk_count, number} failed. The other {succeeded_count, number} came through, so there's no need to upload again.
CHUNK_TIMEOUT: Part {chunk_index, number} ran past {timeout_seconds, number} seconds and was stopped.
TRANSCRIPTION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The transcription service didn't answer on part {chunk_index, number}, after {attempts, number} attempts.
AUDIO_IS_SAFE: Your audio is safe. Nothing was lost.
NO_SPEECH_DETECTED: We found no speech in this audio.
LEMMA_GROUPED_BY_STEMMER: We grouped "{term}" by resemblance rather than from the dictionary. Worth a look.
ALLOWANCE_REMAINING: Room for about {whole_episodes_remaining, number} more episodes today, out of a {allowance_hours, number} hour allowance.
HOURLY_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED: This hour's allowance is spent — it's {allowance_hours, number} hours of audio per hour. Carrying on by itself in {minutes_until_reset, number} minutes.
DAILY_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED: Today's allowance is spent — it's {allowance_hours, number} hours of audio per day. It comes back in {hours_until_reset, number} hours.
STORAGE_FULL: Out of room: storage is using {used_bytes, number, ::compact-short} of {limit_bytes, number, ::compact-short}, and this episode needs {needed_bytes, number, ::compact-short}. Delete the audio from older episodes — their statistics stay.
TOPIC_NAME_TAKEN: There's already a running joke called "{name}".
TOPIC_NEEDS_A_TERM: Add at least one word or phrase to count.
TERM_TOO_MANY_WORDS: That phrase has {word_count, number} words and the limit is {max_words, number}.
TOPIC_TERM_LIMIT: A running joke can have up to {max_terms, number} variations.
LIBRARY_TOPIC_LIMIT: You can track up to {max_topics, number} running jokes per series.
ALIAS_SUGGESTED_WRITTEN_VARIANT: The transcriber usually writes "{term}" as "{alias}". Count both?
TOPIC_APPLY_SKIPPED_NO_TRANSCRIPT: Episode {episode_number, number} was skipped because it's still {status}.
EPISODES_STILL_PROCESSING: {processing_count, number} episodes are still processing, so these numbers will change.
DELETE_EPISODE_CONFIRMATION: Delete "{title}" for good? The audio, the transcript and the counts all go.
LIBRARY_EMPTY: No episodes yet. Drag in a file of up to {max_minutes, number} minutes — we accept {accepted}.
NO_TOPICS_YET: No running jokes tracked yet. Start with one you say constantly, like "{suggested_term}".
TOPIC_NO_EPISODES_YET: There are no episodes to count this joke in yet.
SERIES_FIRST_EPISODE: This is the series' first episode. Episode-to-episode comparison starts with the second.
SERIES_NEEDS_SECOND_EPISODE: One episode leaves nothing to compare. Upload the next one and this page comes alive.
TREND_NEEDS_MORE_EPISODES: There are {episode_count, number} episodes and a trend needs at least {minimum, number}.
COUNTS_DESCRIBE_PUBLISHED_EDIT: These counts describe the published episode, not the raw recording — whatever the edit cut doesn't appear.
ANALYSIS_ALWAYS_PTBR: Analysis is always in Brazilian Portuguese. Changing the language here changes the interface only, never a number.
TRANSCRIPT_QUALITY_POOR: Transcription quality came in at {quality_score, number} out of 100, below {threshold, number}. Treat these counts with suspicion.
AUDIO_MAY_NOT_BE_PTBR: This audio may not be in Portuguese — we detected {detected_language}, at quality {quality_score, number} out of 100.
SHARE_LINK_DISCLOSURE: Anyone with the link can see this episode's counts and quotes without signing in. The full transcript is not shown.
ANALYSIS_NOT_SAVED: The transcript came through but the counts were not saved. The audio is safe — try again.
